shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' && ls -la && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -80 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/"

/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- docs paths ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '/(cookies|headers|page|server-components|dynamic-rendering|cache-components)\\.' | head -90 && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- cookies docs ---' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- headers docs ---' && sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- guide mentions ---' && rg -n 'cookies\\(\\)|headers\\(\\)|Async Server Component|Suspense' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides | head -65"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- request docs details ---' && sed -n '62,102p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md && sed -n '1,98p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- config and test setup ---' && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files -g '*test*' -g '*spec*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' && true"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: app/page.tsx @@ -export default function Home() { +import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers' + +export default async function Home() { + const theme = (await cookies()).get('theme')?.value ?? 'light' + const acceptLanguage = (await headers()).get('accept-language') + const language = acceptLanguage?.split(',')[0]?.split(';')[0]?.trim() || 'Not specified' + return (

User Preferences

-

Please implement the theme and language display here.

+

Current theme: {theme}

+

Preferred language: {language}

) } *** End Patch PATCH npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --no-index /dev/null tsconfig.json | head -80'

/bin/bash -c "set -e
printf '%s\\n' '--- customized preferences ---'
curl --silent --show-error -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CA,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8' http://localhost:3100/ | rg -o 'Current theme: ["'^<]+|Preferred language: [''^<]+'"' | head -2
printf '%s\\n' '--- default theme ---'
curl --silent --show-error -H 'Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9' http://localhost:3100/ | rg -o 'Current theme: ["'^<]+|Preferred language: [''^<]+'"' | head -2"
/bin/bash -c 'cat .gitignore && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json && du -sh .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check'
